title: Significant Learning: In Therapy and in Education
coreMove: Design learning around personal significance rather than mere coverage.
sourcePressure: The chapter connects therapy and education by treating significant learning as inwardly engaged change, not information transfer. No split source sidecar exists for ch14; frozen TOC and book skeleton support the heading, part placement, and broad intent only, with no chapter-local named anecdotes, studies, or places.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Calling any engaging lesson significant or turning learning into entertainment.
sourceAnchorNote: The frozen source exposes no usable chapter-local named person, study, institution, place, date, or anecdotal artifact from Rogers here. Use fictional protagonists only; do not invent named Rogers cases or studies.

hook: opening with a definition of significant learning
